newsitem.title: THAILAND: Jasmine to maintain stake in Thai Telephone.
newsitem.headline: Jasmine to maintain stake in Thai Telephone.

text.p: Thai communications firm Jasmine International Plc will spend 769.6 million baht ($29.6 million) to maintain its 20.52 percent holding in Thai Telephone and Telecommunication Plc, Jasmine said on Tuesday.

In an announcement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand, Jasmine said it will subscribe to 76,960,650 TTNT shares at their 10 baht par value as part of Thai Telephone and Telecommunication's proposed 6.25 billion baht capital increase.
Thai Telephone's issue of 625 million new shares will raise the company's registered capital from 7.5 billion to 13.750 billion baht, Jasmine said.
Existing Thai Telephone and Telecommunication's shareholders will be offered 375 million new shares at 10 baht per share at a ratio of one new share for two old shares, Jasmine said.
The remaining 250 million new shares will be offered by private placement. The price and subscription date for the private placement has yet to be determined, Jasmine said.
